article.title: Is still smells of sulphur: 20 years since Chávez’s speech at the UN
article.author: Editor
article.content: On 20 September 2006, Hugo Chávez stepped up to the granite podium of the United Nations General Assembly. A day earlier, from that exact same spot, the President of the United States, George W. Bush, had spoken.
